caption:
78 facilities: Digital Realty leads the US in the Coloprice ranking of operators by tracked facilities.

Equinix follows with 76, then DataBank with 75, Flexential with 45 and QTS Data Centers with 44. The US has 1351 tracked facilities across 339 operators.

Facility count is not capacity: QTS publishes 2,473 MW from 23 of its sites, while Digital Realty publishes 91 MW (7 of 78 sites). Largest by tracked facilities, not an endorsement.

Data: Coloprice operator rankings, 18 Nov 2026. Sources on the last slide.
